blocks.zh: 導論與培養法
blocks.en: Introduction and Culture Method

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 了解黴漿菌（Mycoplasma）的生物學特性：無細胞壁的最小自我複製原核生物
blocks.en: Understand the biology of mycoplasma: the smallest self-replicating prokaryotes, with no cell wall

blocks.zh: 理解 USP ⟨63⟩ 規定的兩種法定檢測方法：(A) 培養法與 (B) 指示細胞培養法
blocks.en: Understand the two compendial test methods required by USP ⟨63⟩: (A) the culture method and (B) the indicator cell culture method

blocks.zh: 掌握培養法的培養基選擇、品質管控菌株、接種條件及判讀標準
blocks.en: Master media selection, quality control strains, inoculation conditions and interpretation criteria for the culture method

blocks.zh: 認識抑制物質（Inhibitory Substances）測試的必要性與方法
blocks.en: Recognize why and how to test for inhibitory substances

blocks.zh: 了解推薦培養基（Hayflick、Frey、Friis）的配方設計邏輯與適用範圍
blocks.en: Understand the formulation logic and scope of use of the recommended media (Hayflick, Frey, Friis)

blocks.zh: 0.1 Introduction — 導論
blocks.en: 0.1 Introduction

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: 黴漿菌（Mycoplasma）是什麼？
blocks.en: What is mycoplasma?

blocks.zh: 最小的自我複製原核生物 — 比一般細菌小得多（0.2–0.3 µm），能通過某些除菌過濾器
blocks.en: The smallest self-replicating prokaryotes — much smaller than ordinary bacteria (0.2–0.3 µm), and able to pass through some sterilizing-grade filters

blocks.zh: 沒有細胞壁 — 這是關鍵特性。因為沒有細胞壁，所以：(1) 無法用革蘭氏染色法（Gram stain）檢測；(2) 對作用於細胞壁的抗生素（如青黴素類）天然耐藥；(3) 形態多變，不易在一般微生物檢驗中辨識
blocks.en: No cell wall — this is the defining feature. Because there is no cell wall: (1) they cannot be detected by Gram stain; (2) they are naturally resistant to antibiotics that act on the cell wall (such as penicillins); (3) their morphology is highly variable, so they are hard to recognize in routine microbiological testing

blocks.zh: 超過 120 個物種 — 不同物種有不同的營養需求與宿主偏好，這也是為什麼需要多種培養基來檢測
blocks.en: More than 120 species — different species have different nutritional requirements and host preferences, which is why more than one medium is needed for detection

blocks.zh: 為什麼黴漿菌對 CDMO 特別危險？
blocks.en: Why is mycoplasma especially dangerous for a CDMO?

blocks.zh: 感染可以「無聲無息」持續 — 不造成明顯的細胞損傷或培養液混濁
blocks.en: Infection can persist "silently" — with no obvious cell damage or turbidity in the culture

blocks.zh: 影響幾乎所有細胞代謝途徑 — 改變細胞表型和生長特性，直接影響生物製品的品質
blocks.en: It affects almost every cellular metabolic pathway — altering cell phenotype and growth characteristics, and directly affecting biological product quality

blocks.zh: 細胞庫（Cell Bank）一旦被污染，整條產品線都可能受影響
blocks.en: Once a cell bank is contaminated, the entire product line may be affected

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 看不見的室友：
blocks.en: The invisible roommate:

blocks.zh: 想像你的細胞培養瓶是一間公寓，裡面住著你精心培養的 CHO 細胞。黴漿菌就像是一個偷偷搬進來的隱形室友 — 牠不會把房間弄得很亂（不造成明顯混濁），不會發出噪音（不造成明顯細胞損傷），但牠會偷偷動用你的食物（消耗培養基營養素）、調整恆溫器（改變 pH）、甚至重新布置家具（改變細胞代謝和表型）。
blocks.en: Imagine your cell culture flask is an apartment, home to the CHO cells you have carefully nurtured. Mycoplasma is like an invisible roommate who has quietly moved in — it does not make a mess (no obvious turbidity) and does not make noise (no obvious cell damage), but it quietly helps itself to your food (consuming medium nutrients), adjusts the thermostat (changing pH), and even rearranges the furniture (altering cell metabolism and phenotype).

blocks.zh: 最可怕的是，你可能完全不知道牠在那裡 — 直到你的「房客」（細胞產品）出了品質問題。這就是為什麼你需要定期「驗屋」（黴漿菌測試）。
blocks.en: The scariest part is that you may have no idea it is there — until your "tenant" (the cell product) develops a quality problem. This is why you need regular "inspections" (mycoplasma testing).

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: USP ⟨63⟩ 的法定地位：這不是一份「建議」文件，而是美國藥典的正式通用章節（General Chapter）。對於在美國上市的生物製品，本章所述的黴漿菌測試是法定要求。
blocks.en: The legal status of USP ⟨63⟩: This is not a "recommendation" document; it is an official General Chapter of the United States Pharmacopeia. For biological products marketed in the US, the mycoplasma testing described in this chapter is a compendial requirement.

blocks.zh: 兩種方法缺一不可：USP ⟨63⟩ 要求同時使用培養法 (A) 和指示細胞培養法 (B)。如果要使用替代方法（NAT 或酶活性方法），必須證明其與兩種標準方法的「可比較性」（comparability）。
blocks.en: Both methods are indispensable: USP ⟨63⟩ requires the use of both the culture method (A) and the indicator cell culture method (B). If an alternative method (NAT or an enzyme activity-based method) is to be used, it must be shown to be "comparable" to both standard methods.

blocks.zh: CDMO 商業影響：黴漿菌污染事件是生物製藥中最嚴重的品質事故之一。一次污染可能導致整批產品報廢、產線停工、細胞庫銷毀、FDA 483 觀察項，甚至產品召回。
blocks.en: Commercial impact for a CDMO: A mycoplasma contamination event is one of the most serious quality incidents in biopharmaceutical manufacturing. A single contamination can lead to rejected batches, production line shutdown, destruction of cell banks, FDA 483 observations, and even product recalls.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼黴漿菌能通過某些 0.2 µm 的除菌過濾器？這對你的無菌生產操作有什麼啟示？
blocks.en: Why can mycoplasma pass through some 0.2 µm sterilizing filters? What does this imply for your aseptic manufacturing operations?

blocks.zh: 原文提到黴漿菌感染「不一定造成培養液混濁」。在你的 CDMO 日常品管中，僅依靠目視檢查來排除微生物污染是否足夠？
blocks.en: The source text notes that mycoplasma infection does not necessarily cause turbid culture fluid. In day-to-day CDMO quality control, is visual inspection alone sufficient to rule out microbial contamination?

blocks.zh: 如果你的客戶要求使用 NAT 方法取代傳統培養法，你需要提供什麼樣的驗證數據來滿足 USP ⟨63⟩ 的要求？
blocks.en: If your client asks you to use a NAT method in place of the traditional culture method, what validation data must you provide to meet the requirements of USP ⟨63⟩?

blocks.zh: 0.2 Culture Method — Choice of Media — 培養法：培養基選擇
blocks.en: 0.2 Culture Method — Choice of Media

blocks.zh: 為什麼需要固體和液體兩種培養基？
blocks.en: Why are both solid and liquid media needed?

blocks.zh: 液體培養基（Broth） — 提供更豐富的營養環境，有利於低濃度黴漿菌的增殖；含酚紅（phenol red）作為 pH 指示劑，黴漿菌代謝會改變 pH 造成顏色變化
blocks.en: Liquid medium (broth) — provides a richer nutrient environment that favors the multiplication of low concentrations of mycoplasma; it contains phenol red as a pH indicator, so mycoplasma metabolism changes the pH and causes a color change

blocks.zh: 固體培養基（Agar） — 用於觀察黴漿菌典型的「煎蛋狀」菌落（fried-egg colony），這是確認性鑑定的關鍵
blocks.en: Solid medium (agar) — used to observe the typical "fried-egg" colonies of mycoplasma, which is key to confirmatory identification

blocks.zh: 兩大代謝類型的正控菌：
blocks.en: Positive control strains for the two major metabolic types:

blocks.zh: 葡萄糖發酵者（Dextrose fermenter） — 如 M. pneumoniae，會將培養基 pH 降低（酚紅變黃）
blocks.en: Dextrose fermenter — such as M. pneumoniae, which lowers the medium pH (phenol red turns yellow)

blocks.zh: 精胺酸水解者（Arginine hydrolyzer） — 如 M. orale，會將培養基 pH 升高（酚紅變粉紅/紫紅）
blocks.en: Arginine hydrolyzer — such as M. orale, which raises the medium pH (phenol red turns pink/magenta)

blocks.zh: 選擇這兩種代謝類型作為正控，確保培養基能支持不同營養需求的黴漿菌生長。
blocks.en: These two metabolic types are chosen as positive controls to ensure that the medium supports the growth of mycoplasma with different nutritional requirements.

blocks.zh: 餐廳的菜單多樣性：
blocks.en: Menu variety at a restaurant:

blocks.zh: 想像你開了一家餐廳，要證明你的廚房能滿足各種客人的需求。你不能只請一位喜歡吃牛排的試吃員來驗證 — 你還需要一位素食者。葡萄糖發酵者就像「肉食主義者」，精胺酸水解者就像「素食者」。如果這兩種截然不同口味的客人都能在你的餐廳吃得飽、吃得好，那你就有信心你的培養基（菜單）能支持各種黴漿菌的生長。
blocks.en: Imagine you have opened a restaurant and need to prove that your kitchen can satisfy all kinds of guests. You cannot validate it with a taster who only likes steak — you also need a vegetarian. The dextrose fermenter is like the "meat lover" and the arginine hydrolyzer is like the "vegetarian." If both of these very different guests can eat well and be satisfied at your restaurant, you can be confident that your medium (the menu) supports the growth of a wide range of mycoplasma.

blocks.zh: 15 代傳代限制：正控菌株不得超過分離後 15 代（passages）。這是因為黴漿菌在反覆傳代過程中可能發生表型或基因型改變，導致其生長特性不再代表野生型。保存方式應為冷凍（−20°C 或更低）或凍乾。
blocks.en: The 15-passage limit: Positive control strains must not exceed 15 passages from isolation. This is because mycoplasma may undergo phenotypic or genotypic changes during repeated passaging, so that their growth characteristics no longer represent the wild type. Storage should be frozen (−20°C or colder) or freeze-dried.

blocks.zh: 菌株選擇與產品類型的關聯：注意每個菌株的適用場景都與產品來源或用途直接相關。例如，如果你的 CDMO 使用禽類來源的原料生產疫苗，你必須包含 M. gallisepticum 和 M. synoviae 作為品管菌株。
blocks.en: Link between strain selection and product type: Note that the applicability of each strain is directly tied to the source or use of the product. For example, if your CDMO manufactures vaccines using avian-derived raw materials, you must include M. gallisepticum and M. synoviae as quality control strains.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務：大多數 CDMO 的生物製品生產線使用哺乳類細胞（CHO、Vero、HEK293），最常用的正控組合是 M. pneumoniae（或 M. fermentans）+ M. orale。
blocks.en: CDMO practice: Most CDMO biologics production lines use mammalian cells (CHO, Vero, HEK293), and the most common positive control combination is M. pneumoniae (or M. fermentans) + M. orale.

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 同時承接人用疫苗和獸用疫苗的生產。請列出你的黴漿菌檢測計畫中應包含哪些品管菌株？
blocks.en: Your CDMO manufactures both human and veterinary vaccines. Which quality control strains should your mycoplasma testing program include?

blocks.zh: 為什麼液體培養基中必須含有酚紅？如果不加酚紅，會對檢測結果的判讀造成什麼影響？
blocks.en: Why must liquid medium contain phenol red? If it were omitted, how would that affect the interpretation of test results?

blocks.zh: 正控菌株的「15 代限制」在你的 QC 實驗室中要如何管理和追蹤？
blocks.en: How would you manage and track the "15-passage limit" for positive control strains in your QC laboratory?

blocks.zh: 0.3 Incubation Conditions & Nutritive Properties — 培養條件與營養性質
blocks.en: 0.3 Incubation Conditions & Nutritive Properties

blocks.zh: 微需氧條件（Microaerophilic Conditions）：
blocks.en: Microaerophilic conditions:

blocks.zh: 黴漿菌不是嚴格的厭氧菌，也不是好氧菌 — 它們需要低氧環境
blocks.en: Mycoplasma are neither strict anaerobes nor aerobes — they require a low-oxygen environment

blocks.zh: 固體培養基需要 < 0.5% 氧氣 + 5%–10% CO<sub>2</sub> 的氣體環境
blocks.en: Solid medium requires an atmosphere of < 0.5% oxygen + 5%–10% CO<sub>2</sub>

blocks.zh: 液體培養基使用密封容器，容器內的液面上方自然形成低氧環境
blocks.en: Liquid medium is incubated in tightly closed containers, where a low-oxygen environment forms naturally above the liquid surface

blocks.zh: 0.5-log 範圍的意義：
blocks.en: Meaning of the 0.5-log range:

blocks.zh: 接種 100 cfu，回收計數必須在 0.5-log 範圍內。這意味著回收數應在 ~32 到 ~316 cfu 之間（10<sup>1.5</sup> 到 10<sup>2.5</sup>）。這個標準確保培養基既有足夠的營養支持生長，又不會有過度促進生長的成分干擾結果。
blocks.en: When 100 cfu is inoculated, the recovered count must fall within a 0.5-log range. This means the recovery should be between ~32 and ~316 cfu (10<sup>1.5</sup> to 10<sup>2.5</sup>). This criterion ensures that the medium provides enough nutrients to support growth, without containing components that promote growth excessively and distort the result.

blocks.zh: 培養基的「品質驗收」：
blocks.en: "Quality acceptance" of media:

blocks.zh: 就像你不會用未經校準的天平來秤量關鍵原料一樣，你也不能用未經驗證的培養基來進行黴漿菌檢測。Growth Promotion 測試就是培養基的「校準程序」— 你放入已知數量的「標準品」（100 cfu 的品管菌株），看培養基能不能「準確讀取」（在 0.5-log 範圍內回收）。如果回收太少，表示培養基營養不足；如果回收太多，可能有問題需要調查。
blocks.en: Just as you would not weigh a critical raw material on an uncalibrated balance, you cannot test for mycoplasma with unqualified medium. The growth promotion test is the "calibration procedure" for the medium — you load a known quantity of "reference standard" (100 cfu of a QC strain) and see whether the medium can "read it accurately" (recovery within the 0.5-log range). If recovery is too low, the medium is nutritionally deficient; if it is too high, there may be a problem that needs investigation.

blocks.zh: 每批培養基都要驗證：原文明確要求「each new batch of medium」都要進行營養性質測試。這在 CDMO 中意味著你的 QC 實驗室必須有一套完整的培養基批次管理程序 — 收到新批次的培養基後，先做 Growth Promotion 測試通過，才能用於正式的黴漿菌檢測。
blocks.en: Every batch of medium must be verified: The source text explicitly requires the nutritive properties test for "each new batch of medium." For a CDMO, this means your QC laboratory must have a complete medium batch management procedure — after receiving a new batch of medium, a growth promotion test must be passed before it can be used for formal mycoplasma testing.

blocks.zh: 溫度精度 36 ± 1°C：這個溫度範圍比一般細菌培養的 30–35°C 要高一些。培養箱的溫度校準和日常監控是確保測試有效性的基本條件。
blocks.en: Temperature precision of 36 ± 1°C: This temperature range is somewhat higher than the 30–35°C used for general bacterial culture. Incubator temperature calibration and routine monitoring are basic conditions for ensuring test validity.

blocks.zh: 你的 QC 實驗室收到一批新的 Hayflick 培養基。請描述你會如何執行 Growth Promotion 測試的完整流程。
blocks.en: Your QC laboratory receives a new batch of Hayflick medium. Describe the complete procedure you would follow to perform the growth promotion test.

blocks.zh: 如果固體培養基的回收計數超出 0.5-log 範圍（例如接種 100 cfu 但回收 500 cfu），你應該如何調查和處理？
blocks.en: If the recovery count on solid medium falls outside the 0.5-log range (for example, 100 cfu inoculated but 500 cfu recovered), how should you investigate and handle it?

blocks.zh: 0.4 Inhibitory Substances — 抑制物質測試
blocks.en: 0.4 Inhibitory Substances

blocks.zh: 為什麼要做抑制物質測試？
blocks.en: Why test for inhibitory substances?

blocks.zh: 你的產品（例如生物製劑的上清液或細胞裂解液）可能含有能抑制黴漿菌生長的物質 — 例如殘留的抗生素、防腐劑、或高濃度的鹽/蛋白質。如果這些物質抑制了黴漿菌的生長，你的檢測結果可能出現「假陰性」— 明明有污染但測不到。
blocks.en: Your product (for example, a biologic supernatant or cell lysate) may contain substances that inhibit mycoplasma growth, such as residual antibiotics, preservatives, or high concentrations of salt or protein. If these substances inhibit mycoplasma growth, your test may give a "false negative" — contamination is present but not detected.

blocks.zh: 判定標準（兩個指標）：
blocks.en: Acceptance criteria (two indicators):

blocks.zh: 時間差異 — 如果不含產品的對照組比含產品的測試組早超過 1 次繼代（subculture）就出現生長，表示產品有抑制性
blocks.en: Time difference — if growth appears in the control without product more than one subculture earlier than in the test with product, the product is inhibitory

blocks.zh: 計數差異 — 直接接種的平板上，含產品組的菌落數與不含產品組的差異超出 0.5-log 範圍
blocks.en: Count difference — on directly inoculated plates, the difference in colony counts between the product-containing and product-free groups falls outside the 0.5-log range

blocks.zh: 驗孕棒的干擾物質測試：
blocks.en: Interfering-substance testing for a pregnancy test strip:

blocks.zh: 想像你在驗證一支驗孕棒 — 你不只要確認它對已知的 hCG 陽性樣本能正確顯示陽性，你還要確認受測者的尿液中沒有什麼成分會干擾檢測結果（例如某些藥物可能導致假陰性）。抑制物質測試就是在做同樣的事：確認你的產品不會「毒死」培養基中的黴漿菌，導致你誤以為沒有污染。
blocks.en: Imagine you are validating a pregnancy test strip — you must not only confirm that it correctly shows positive for a known hCG-positive sample, but also confirm that nothing in the subject's urine interferes with the result (for example, some medications could cause a false negative). Inhibitory substances testing does the same thing: it confirms that your product does not "kill" the mycoplasma in the medium, leading you to wrongly believe there is no contamination.

blocks.zh: 一次性驗證，製程變更時重做：抑制物質測試只需要對特定產品做一次。但如果製程發生可能影響黴漿菌檢測的變更（例如更換培養基成分、新增抗生素使用步驟、改變純化方法），就必須重新驗證。
blocks.en: Performed once; repeat when the process changes: The inhibitory substances test only needs to be performed once for a given product. However, if the process changes in a way that could affect mycoplasma detection (for example, changing medium components, adding an antibiotic step, or changing the purification method), it must be repeated.

blocks.zh: 中和策略的常見做法：
blocks.en: Common neutralization strategies:

blocks.zh: 稀釋法 — 在更大體積的培養基中稀釋產品，降低抑制物質的有效濃度
blocks.en: Dilution — dilute the product in a larger volume of medium to lower the effective concentration of the inhibitory substance

blocks.zh: 傳代法 — 先在不含抑制物質的基質中傳代，讓細胞代謝掉抑制物質
blocks.en: Passaging — passage first in a substrate without the inhibitory substance, allowing the cells to metabolize it away

blocks.zh: 關鍵：無論用什麼方法，都必須重做抑制物質測試來確認中和有效
blocks.en: Key point: Whichever method is used, the inhibitory substances test must be repeated to confirm that the neutralization is effective

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 正在生產一款含有高濃度青黴素的生物製品。青黴素對一般細菌有效，但對黴漿菌無效（因為黴漿菌無細胞壁）。在這種情況下，你需要做抑制物質測試嗎？為什麼？
blocks.en: Your CDMO is manufacturing a biologic containing a high concentration of penicillin. Penicillin is effective against ordinary bacteria but not against mycoplasma (because mycoplasma have no cell wall). In this case, do you need to perform the inhibitory substances test? Why?

blocks.zh: 如果抑制物質測試顯示你的產品確實有抑制性，你選擇用稀釋法來中和。請問你如何確定最適當的稀釋倍數？
blocks.en: If the inhibitory substances test shows that your product is indeed inhibitory and you choose dilution to neutralize it, how would you determine the most appropriate dilution factor?

blocks.zh: 0.5 Test for Mycoplasma in the Test Article/Material — 檢品之黴漿菌測試
blocks.en: 0.5 Test for Mycoplasma in the Test Article/Material

blocks.zh: 28 天的偵探調查：
blocks.en: A 28-day detective investigation:

blocks.zh: 培養法就像派出一組偵探進行長達四週的監視行動。你不是只在第一天看一眼就下結論 — 你要在不同時間點（Day 2-4, 6-8, 13-15, 19-21）反覆從「暗號」（液體培養基的顏色變化）中尋找線索，並且定期採集「證據」（繼代到固體培養基上看有沒有長出典型菌落）。這個 28 天的等待期是培養法最大的缺點，也是為什麼產業界一直在開發更快速的替代方法（如 NAT/PCR）。
blocks.en: The culture method is like sending a team of detectives on a four-week surveillance operation. You do not look once on the first day and draw a conclusion — you repeatedly look for clues at different time points (Days 2–4, 6–8, 13–15, 19–21) from the "signals" (color changes in the liquid medium), and periodically collect "evidence" (subculturing onto solid medium to see whether typical colonies grow). This 28-day wait is the biggest drawback of the culture method, and it is why industry keeps developing faster alternative methods (such as NAT/PCR).

blocks.zh: 10 mL / 100 mL 的最低接種比例：這個比例確保有足夠的檢品進入培養系統。如果接種量太少，可能錯過低濃度的污染。
blocks.en: The minimum inoculation ratio of 10 mL per 100 mL: This ratio ensures that enough test article enters the culture system. If the inoculum is too small, a low-level contamination may be missed.

blocks.zh: pH 調整：某些生物製品可能是酸性或鹼性的，加入培養基後會改變 pH。由於酚紅的顏色變化依賴 pH，必須先將 pH 調回原始值，否則無法區分「產品造成的 pH 變化」和「黴漿菌代謝造成的 pH 變化」。
blocks.en: pH adjustment: Some biological products may be acidic or alkaline and will change the pH when added to the medium. Because the color change of phenol red depends on pH, the pH must first be adjusted back to its original value; otherwise you cannot distinguish a pH change caused by the product from one caused by mycoplasma metabolism.

blocks.zh: CDMO 排程影響：28 天的測試週期意味著你需要在產品放行時間表中預留足夠的 QC 測試時間。對於需要快速放行的細胞治療產品，這個時間線往往是不可接受的 — 這正是 NAT/PCR 快速方法的商業價值所在。
blocks.en: Impact on CDMO scheduling: A 28-day test cycle means you must allow sufficient QC testing time in the product release schedule. For cell therapy products that need rapid release, this timeline is often unacceptable — which is exactly the commercial value of rapid NAT/PCR methods.

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 正在評估是否採用 NAT（qPCR）方法來縮短黴漿菌檢測的放行時間。相比培養法的 28 天，NAT 可以在數小時內出結果。請分析這個決策的利與弊。
blocks.en: Your CDMO is evaluating whether to adopt a NAT (qPCR) method to shorten the release time for mycoplasma testing. Compared with the 28 days of the culture method, NAT can deliver results within hours. Analyze the pros and cons of this decision.

blocks.zh: 在測試的第 7 天，你觀察到液體培養基出現明顯的混濁。這代表什麼？你接下來應該做什麼？
blocks.en: On Day 7 of the test, you observe obvious turbidity in the liquid medium. What does this indicate? What should you do next?

blocks.zh: 原文提到正控菌株應「regular rotation」使用。為什麼輪換使用正控菌株比固定使用同一菌株更好？
blocks.en: The source text says positive control strains should be used in "regular rotation." Why is rotating positive control strains better than always using the same strain?

blocks.zh: 測試時間線（21 天流程）：
blocks.en: Test timeline (21-day process):

blocks.zh: 整個測試從開始到出結果需要約 28 天。
blocks.en: The whole test takes about 28 days from start to result.

blocks.zh: 0.6 Interpretation of Results (Culture Method) — 結果判讀（培養法）
blocks.en: 0.6 Interpretation of Results (Culture Method)

blocks.zh: 警報器的定期測試：
blocks.en: Regular testing of an alarm:

blocks.zh: 就像你家的煙霧偵測器 — 你定期按下測試按鈕（正控），確認它能正常發出警報。同時你也確認在沒有煙霧的情況下它不會亂響（負控）。只有當偵測器同時通過這兩個測試時，你才能信任它在火災時的判斷。黴漿菌檢測的正/負控邏輯完全相同。
blocks.en: Think of the smoke detector at home — you regularly press the test button (positive control) to confirm it sounds the alarm properly. You also confirm that it does not go off when there is no smoke (negative control). Only when the detector passes both tests can you trust its judgment in a real fire. The positive/negative control logic of mycoplasma testing is exactly the same.

blocks.zh: 疑似菌落的處理：如果在固體培養基上看到「疑似」但不典型的菌落，不能直接報告為陽性或陰性 — 必須使用驗證過的確認方法（例如 PCR 或特殊染色）來進一步鑑定。這個步驟需要有 SOP 並記錄在批次紀錄中。
blocks.en: Handling suspect colonies: If you see "suspect" but atypical colonies on solid medium, you cannot report them directly as positive or negative — you must use a validated confirmatory method (such as PCR or special staining) for further identification. This step requires an SOP and must be recorded in the batch record.

blocks.zh: 測試無效的代價：對 CDMO 而言，測試無效意味著需要重新開始整個 28 天流程 — 這可能嚴重延遲產品放行時間表。因此，實驗室環境控制、培養基品質管理和正控菌株管理至關重要。
blocks.en: The cost of an invalid test: For a CDMO, an invalid test means restarting the entire 28-day process, which can seriously delay the product release schedule. Laboratory environmental control, medium quality management and positive control strain management are therefore critical.

blocks.zh: 你的 QC 團隊報告：正控有生長，負控無生長，但檢品的固體培養基上出現了看起來不太典型的小菌落。作為 QC 主管，你的處理步驟是什麼？
blocks.en: Your QC team reports: the positive control shows growth, the negative control shows no growth, but small colonies that do not look quite typical appear on the solid medium for the test article. As QC head, what steps do you take?

blocks.zh: 如果負控出現了黴漿菌生長（測試無效），你的調查方向有哪些？需要做哪些 CAPA？
blocks.en: If growth of mycoplasma appears in the negative control (invalid test), what lines of investigation would you pursue? What CAPA would be needed?

blocks.zh: 四種可能的結果：
blocks.en: Four possible outcomes:

blocks.zh: 關鍵邏輯：正控必須有生長（證明測試系統有能力檢測黴漿菌），負控必須無生長（排除實驗室環境污染）。只有這兩個條件都滿足時，檢品的結果才有意義。
blocks.en: Key logic: The positive control must show growth (proving the test system is capable of detecting mycoplasma), and the negative control must show no growth (ruling out laboratory environmental contamination). Only when both conditions are met is the test article result meaningful.

blocks.zh: 0.7 Recommended Solutions and Media — 推薦溶液與培養基
blocks.en: 0.7 Recommended Solutions and Media

blocks.zh: 針對不同魚種的專用魚餌：
blocks.en: Specialized bait for different kinds of fish:

blocks.zh: Hayflick 培養基就像通用魚餌 — 大部分的魚都會被吸引。Frey 培養基則是專門為了釣一種特別挑食的魚（M. synoviae）而設計的特殊魚餌，需要加入牠特別喜歡的營養素（β-NAD）。Friis 培養基則像是把所有最好的魚餌都混在一起的「終極配方」，確保各種非禽類黴漿菌都能被引誘出來。
blocks.en: Hayflick medium is like a general-purpose bait — most fish are attracted to it. Frey medium is a special bait designed to catch one particularly picky fish (M. synoviae), and it needs the nutrient that fish especially likes (β-NAD). Friis medium is like an "ultimate formula" that mixes all the best baits together, ensuring that all kinds of non-avian mycoplasma are lured out.

blocks.zh: 「本節為參考性質」：原文特別標註 "[Note — This section is provided for information.]"。這意味著你可以使用其他滿足營養性質要求的培養基，不一定要用這三種。但在實務中，這三種培養基（尤其是 Hayflick）已成為業界的「黃金標準」配方。
blocks.en: "This section is provided for information": The source text specifically notes "[Note — This section is provided for information.]" This means you may use other media that meet the nutritive properties requirements and are not obliged to use these three. In practice, however, these three media (especially Hayflick) have become the "gold standard" formulations in industry.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務考量：
blocks.en: CDMO practical considerations:

blocks.zh: 大多數 CDMO 購買商業化的現成培養基（如 BD PPLO Agar/Broth），而不是自行調配
blocks.en: Most CDMOs buy commercially prepared ready-made media (such as BD PPLO Agar/Broth) rather than preparing their own

blocks.zh: 自行調配的好處是可以完全控制成分品質，但需要更嚴格的批次管理
blocks.en: The advantage of in-house preparation is full control over ingredient quality, but it requires stricter batch management

blocks.zh: 無論使用商業化還是自製培養基，都必須通過 Growth Promotion 測試
blocks.en: Whether commercial or in-house, the medium must pass a growth promotion test

blocks.zh: 如果你的 CDMO 主要生產人用單株抗體（使用 CHO 細胞），你會選擇哪種培養基組合進行黴漿菌檢測？為什麼？
blocks.en: If your CDMO mainly manufactures human monoclonal antibodies (using CHO cells), which medium combination would you choose for mycoplasma testing, and why?

blocks.zh: Hayflick 培養基中加入馬血清（未加熱）而 Frey 培養基中使用豬血清（56°C 滅活 30 分鐘）。為什麼兩者的血清處理方式不同？這有什麼科學考量？
blocks.en: Hayflick medium contains horse serum (unheated), whereas Frey medium uses swine serum (inactivated at 56°C for 30 minutes). Why are the two sera treated differently? What is the scientific rationale?

blocks.zh: 三種培養基的設計邏輯：
blocks.en: Design logic of the three media:

blocks.zh: 為什麼加青黴素（Penicillin）？
blocks.en: Why add penicillin?

blocks.zh: 青黴素作用於細胞壁合成 — 黴漿菌沒有細胞壁，所以不受影響。但一般細菌會被青黴素殺死。因此，加入青黴素是為了抑制普通細菌污染，讓黴漿菌能在沒有競爭者的環境中生長，提高檢測靈敏度。
blocks.en: Penicillin acts on cell wall synthesis — mycoplasma have no cell wall and so are unaffected, whereas ordinary bacteria are killed by penicillin. Penicillin is therefore added to suppress contamination by common bacteria, allowing mycoplasma to grow without competitors and improving test sensitivity.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 黴漿菌（Mycoplasma）是無細胞壁的最小自我複製原核生物，能造成「隱性」的細胞培養污染 — 沒有明顯的混濁或細胞損傷
blocks.en: Mycoplasma are the smallest self-replicating prokaryotes, with no cell wall, and can cause "hidden" cell culture contamination — with no obvious turbidity or cell damage

blocks.zh: USP ⟨63⟩ 法定要求同時使用兩種檢測方法：培養法 (A) 和指示細胞培養法 (B)；替代方法（NAT/PCR）必須證明與兩者可比較
blocks.en: The compendial requirement of USP ⟨63⟩ is to use two test methods together: the culture method (A) and the indicator cell culture method (B); alternative methods (NAT/PCR) must be shown to be comparable to both

blocks.zh: 培養法的正控策略：至少兩株 — 一株葡萄糖發酵者（如 M. pneumoniae）+ 一株精胺酸水解者（如 M. orale）— 確保培養基支持不同代謝類型的黴漿菌
blocks.en: Positive control strategy for the culture method: at least two strains — one dextrose fermenter (such as M. pneumoniae) + one arginine hydrolyzer (such as M. orale) — to ensure the medium supports mycoplasma of different metabolic types

blocks.zh: 抑制物質測試確認產品不會干擾黴漿菌生長（造成假陰性）；一次驗證，製程變更時重做
blocks.en: The inhibitory substances test confirms that the product does not interfere with mycoplasma growth (which would cause false negatives); performed once and repeated when the process changes

blocks.zh: 培養法時程約 28 天：包含多次繼代觀察和至少 14 天的固體培養基培養期
blocks.en: The culture method takes about 28 days: including multiple subculture observations and a solid medium incubation period of at least 14 days

blocks.zh: 判讀邏輯：正控必須有生長、負控必須無生長，檢品結果才有效；疑似菌落需進一步確認
blocks.en: Interpretation logic: the positive control must show growth and the negative control must show no growth for the test article result to be valid; suspect colonies require further confirmation

blocks.zh: 推薦培養基：Hayflick（通用）、Frey（禽類）、Friis（非禽類）— 設計邏輯基於不同黴漿菌物種的營養需求
blocks.en: Recommended media: Hayflick (general), Frey (avian), Friis (non-avian) — the design logic is based on the nutritional requirements of different mycoplasma species
